records.title: CLoSeR: Closing the Loop for Long-Context Streaming Reconstruction
records.reason: Streaming 3D reconstruction and loop closure, not LLM/VLM inference or serving.

records.title: GeoLatent: Geometry-Guided Latent Structuring with Routed Optimization for 3D Reasoning
records.reason: 3D spatial latent reasoning architecture; no inference efficiency method for language or vision-language model deployment.

records.title: OmniSeek: Native Tool Integration for Multi-turn Audio-Visual Reasoning
records.reason: OmniSeek uses selective temporal audio/video evidence retrieval with native tools rather than processing an entire sequence at once. The primary text evaluates long-video/audio-visual reasoning and documents a 32K-token context bottleneck for long raw audio (roughly 90K tokens for two hours). It is an agent/tool integration recipe with no demonstrated direct reduction in LLM inference cost; keep as a weak long-context adjacent item.

records.title: Mitigating Private Data Leakage in LLMs with Whiteout
records.reason: Privacy leakage mitigation/unlearning; no inference-cost or serving improvement.

records.title: Learning What to Investigate Next: Meta-Reasoning for Long-Horizon Research Agents
records.reason: Meta-reasoning architecture for research agents; agent planning/workflow contribution, not direct model inference-resource optimization.
